title: Tracked .claude/settings.json: treatment recommended, awaiting an explicit user decision
decision: Treatment A + C applied as instructed: the committed-blob guard is retained permanently, and the working-tree file was restored to the clean HEAD version.
actions_taken: Verified the HEAD blob for .claude/settings.json contains only the key enabledPlugins, no env block and no credential key, BEFORE restoring.
Ran git restore .claude/settings.json. The file now matches HEAD exactly.
Kept validate-p4.sh section 12b permanently enforced, with POSCTRL-E proving the guard detects a planted credential key.
guard: validate-p4.sh section 12b checks the COMMITTED blob at HEAD, so a credential can never be published by a future commit regardless of what the harness writes to the working tree.
verification: No credential value was read, printed, hashed, logged or transmitted at any point.
No provider-side credential probe was performed.
The repository-wide secret scan returns clean.
The P3 history-credential mutation test passes all four scenarios.

evidence: It is a nested git repository containing a complete duplicate checkout of this project, including its own .claude directory.
The worktree name 'soft-hair' is a generated random identifier, not a meaningful project name.
It contains build and test output artifacts such as .test.out.
The tool ships its own .kilo/.gitignore, confirming it manages its own generated state.
Its .claude/settings.json contains only the key enabledPlugins, with no env block and no credential key.
kilo_worktrees_finding.exclusion_mechanism: .git/info/exclude line 9: .kilo/worktrees/ - added by the tooling itself
kilo_worktrees_finding.action_taken: None. No deletion and no .gitignore change.
kilo_worktrees_finding.rationale: Evidence shows the path is generated tooling state that is ALREADY excluded locally, so there is no current staging hazard and no evidence-based reason to broaden .gitignore. The instruction was not to broaden .gitignore without evidence, and no such evidence of a live hazard exists.
kilo_worktrees_finding.caveat_for_the_user: .git/info/exclude is local and is not committed or shared. A collaborator cloning this repository would not inherit the exclusion and would see .kilo/worktrees as untracked. Whether to commit a shared exclusion is a user decision and was not taken.
kilo_worktrees_finding.also_noted: The .kilo directory itself is not excluded; only .kilo/worktrees is.
